name: gateway-mattermost
description: Outbound-only Mattermost gateway via Incoming Webhook. send POSTs a text message (and optional channel/username/icon overrides) to the configured webhook URL.

credentials.name: mattermost_webhook_url
credentials.description: Mattermost Incoming Webhook URL, e.g. https://mm.example.com/hooks/abcdefg... (env override: COS_MATTERMOST_WEBHOOK_URL)
